A practical owner/developer longlist in North America usually includes the following. **This is not a ranking**—availability, territorial restrictions, property type, required investment, and franchise-versus-management structure vary significantly.

## Most common first-call shortlist

For a typical upscale or upper-upscale lifestyle project, owners frequently screen:

- **Autograph Collection, Tribute Portfolio**
- **Curio Collection, Tapestry Collection, Canopy**
- **Hotel Indigo, Kimpton**
- **JdV by Hyatt, The Unbound Collection, Thompson, Hyatt Centric**
- **Moxy, AC Hotels, Aloft**
- **Cambria, Ascend Hotel Collection**
- **Trademark Collection**
- **Graduate by Hilton**
- **Vignette Collection or voco**
- **Aiden, BW Premier Collection, WorldHotels Crafted**

These cover the principal choices between a **flexible collection/soft brand** and a more prescribed **hard lifestyle brand**.

## Broader North American competitive set

| Owner objective | Brands commonly considered |
|---|---|
| **Preserve an existing hotel’s name, architecture and identity** | **Marriott:** Autograph Collection, Tribute Portfolio, The Luxury Collection. **Hilton:** Curio Collection, Tapestry Collection, Outset Collection, LXR. **Hyatt:** JdV by Hyatt, The Unbound Collection, Destination by Hyatt, Unscripted by Hyatt. **IHG:** Vignette Collection, voco and the newer Noted Collection. ([hotel-development.marriott.com](https://www.hotel-development.marriott.com/brands/premium-brands?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Upper-upscale or luxury, strongly design-led lifestyle** | **Marriott:** W, EDITION, Renaissance, Le Méridien. **Hilton:** NoMad, Canopy, Graduate. **IHG:** Kimpton, Hotel Indigo. **Hyatt:** Thompson, Andaz, Dream, The Standard, Bunkhouse Hotels. ([hotel-development.marriott.com](https://www.hotel-development.marriott.com/brands/luxury-brands?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Upscale, approachable lifestyle** | **Hilton:** Canopy, Tempo. **Hyatt:** Hyatt Centric, JdV. **Choice:** Cambria, Radisson RED. **IHG:** Hotel Indigo, voco. **BWH:** Aiden and Sadie. ([stories.hilton.com](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/qa-with-phil-cordell-lifestyle-category-head?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Efficient/select-service urban lifestyle** | **Marriott:** Moxy, Aloft, AC Hotels and citizenM. **Hilton:** Motto. **Hyatt:** Caption by Hyatt and The StandardX. **IHG:** Ruby. **Wyndham:** TRYP. **BWH:** Aiden and Vīb. ([hotel-development.marriott.com](https://www.hotel-development.marriott.com/brands/select-brands?utm_source=openai)) |
| **College-town positioning** | **Graduate by Hilton** is the clearest specialized option, with each hotel designed around local university culture and traditions. ([stories.hilton.com](https://stories.hilton.com/growth-development/inside-graduate-by-hiltons-next-chapter?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Independent upscale/boutique conversion** | **Choice:** Ascend Hotel Collection and Radisson Individuals. **Wyndham:** Trademark Collection and Dolce. **BWH:** BW Premier Collection, BW Signature Collection and WorldHotels Distinctive/Crafted. **Accor:** Handwritten Collection and MGallery. ([choicehotelsdevelopment.com](https://www.choicehotelsdevelopment.com/sfsites/c/cms/delivery/media/MCUMJCKAM4XNGDBGYQ36NVQN55WE?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Luxury independent collection** | The Luxury Collection, LXR, Vignette Collection, Registry Collection, MGallery, Emblems Collection and the upper tiers of WorldHotels. ([hotel-development.marriott.com](https://www.hotel-development.marriott.com/brands/premium-brands?utm_source=openai)) |
| **High-energy, F&B- and nightlife-led concept** | W, EDITION, Thompson, Dream, The Standard, Kimpton and Accor/Ennismore brands such as **21c Museum Hotels, Mondrian, SLS, The Hoxton, Mama Shelter, Delano and Hyde**. These often involve a more selective development or management process than mainstream franchises. ([hotel-development.marriott.com](https://www.hotel-development.marriott.com/brands/luxury-brands?utm_source=openai)) |

## How owners generally narrow the list

- **Existing distinctive asset or adaptive reuse:** Start with Autograph, Tribute, Curio, Tapestry, Outset, JdV, Unbound, Vignette, Ascend, Radisson Individuals, Trademark and WorldHotels.
- **New-build with a defined lifestyle concept:** Start with Canopy, Hotel Indigo, Kimpton, Thompson, Andaz, Graduate, Moxy, Aloft, Cambria or Aiden.
- **Compact urban economics:** Focus on Moxy, Motto, Caption, Ruby, citizenM, StandardX and TRYP.
- **Luxury with major F&B and residential potential:** Consider EDITION, W, NoMad, Thompson, The Standard, Kimpton, SLS, Mondrian or luxury collection brands.
- **Maximum owner creative control:** Favor a collection/soft brand rather than a hard brand, although the amount of actual flexibility varies considerably by system and deal.

The most directly comparable “distinctive but flexible” owner set is usually **Autograph vs. Curio vs. Unbound vs. Vignette**, followed one tier down by **Tribute vs. Tapestry vs. JdV/Unscripted vs. voco/Noted vs. Ascend vs. Trademark**. Hyatt itself identifies Tribute, Tapestry, voco, Ascend and Trademark as competitors to Unscripted, which illustrates this comparison set. ([hyatt.com](https://www.hyatt.com/development/ourbrands/unscriptedbyhyatt?utm_source=openai))
